selected_work: VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_SET_04:F13 R122 bounded live adoption of the shared producer map for the single exact C2CTestSlipstream callsite 0xBD32E.
summary: R122 preserves the existing right-side sprite-spacing correction at C2CTestSlipstream RVA 0xBD32E while adding an exact fail-closed next-draw ScreenHud handoff sourced from GameSemantic::ClassifyCriticalProducer(CallerRva). The callsite is already classified as C2CTestSlipstream/SCREEN_HUD by disasm_render_contract.hpp, analyze_outrun_exe.py and hud_semantics.hpp. OptionArrow, TextGlyph and DispRank sprani were deliberately excluded because they are outside the current canonical producer ranges.

risk_review.reason: src/hooks_uiscaling.cpp and render_semantics.hpp are protected runtime-risk paths. The change does not widen any producer range or infer HUD ownership from D3D state; it activates only one exact already-canonical ScreenHud producer. R51 runtime evidence shows producer ownership can still arrive too late for the c64/WVP boundary, so hosted CI cannot establish visual correctness.
